summary: A semi-modular drone synth played like an XY pad: four always-on oscillators modulate each other, and the keys move a cursor that shapes filter, modulation and effects instead of playing notes. Still in beta.
features: Four oscillators, 12 waves each, 8 cross-modulation routings
White keys form a 4 x 4 pad; 11 automatic gestures on black keys
Stereo chain: filter, drive, fold, ring, crush, chorus, delay, reverb
Clock set in Hz; ARP and an 8-pattern sequencer with polymetric lanes
MIDI clock and CC in, optional CC out; may overwrite other firmware data

headings: what it keeps, and what it overwrites
